role: Independent129 reviewer clarification only; no gate approval/execution/test or product repair
basis: Re-read normative11 sections5/8 and exact repair2 capture_observation/live_unresolved_capture/live_condition.
correction: The phrase existing valid completed timing witnesses cannot be skipped is overbroad if applied to an aborted callback merely because its later cancellation cleanup clock exists. Callback lifetime is not the same interval as accepted diagnostic capture. A producer can abandon capture on budget expiry, retain actual work busy/unknown, and observe real stopping later without claiming completed capture.
unconditional: Always check rendered bytes after every resolved outcome, including cancelled/terminated. Validate available observed printer bindings; do not demand nonexistent callback or cleanup clocks and do not fabricate condition_ref/full capture.
aborted_timing: For truthful unresolved-to-confirmed-cancel/death outcomes, available native elapsed clocks are descriptive. Do not apply successful-capture deadline assertion to that aborted callback lifetime. Require actual progress, preserved busy/uncertainty and real cleanup/death; later ModeB must verify finite timer, min(request,default) clamp and capture abandonment on actual code paths.
completed_timing: Genuine healthy/completed capture claims retain strict applicable native callback/report deadline assertions. This clarification grants no allowance for successful over-budget capture and no new public schema/result fields.
disposition: Review2 rejection for unconditional byte-budget bypass stands. Author3 may repair only that bounded guard/control gap with this corrected aborted-timing interpretation. Prior counters/history remain unchanged.
